_about: Every call the console can make that changes something, and the Hermes tool that does the same when asked. Read by aura-web/src/lib/hud/actionParity.test.ts (finds each call in the sources) and hermes/plugins/tests/test_action_parity.py (checks each named tool is registered and has a matrix row). status: tool = askable; human-only = a person must do it, with the reason; gap = no tool yet (T-0697 closes them). Raise pinned_gaps only with the new gap's row.

no_prior_value._about: T-1329: a tool an action row names has a change describer (the approval card's Now and Becomes lines, _shared/_approval_hook.CHANGE_DESCRIBERS) or is listed here with the reason it has no value to show. hermes/plugins/tests/test_action_parity.py fails for a tool in neither, and for one in both. The tools with a describer are the ones in tests/contracts/approval-event.json change.tools.
no_prior_value.memory_proposals: a drop is a free row, so no approval is shown, and it replaces no stored value; a keep adds facts, and its card shows each one whole
no_prior_value.persona_switch: a free row: it is never put to the person, so there is no approval to carry the lines (the persona in use is shown on the persona screen)
no_prior_value.llama_swap_load: starts a model: there is no stored value it replaces, and its card already says that the loaded model is swapped out
no_prior_value.llama_swap_unload: stops the resident model: nothing is replaced by a new value, and its card already says the model is swapped out
no_prior_value.map_region_download: adds a region the house does not hold: there is no earlier value, and the row is free so no approval is shown
no_prior_value.map_region_remove: deletes a downloaded region: the value goes away and is not replaced, and the card names the region
no_prior_value.model_download: adds files for a repo: there is no earlier value to replace, and the card names the repo
no_prior_value.model_add: adds a model entry: there is no earlier value to replace, and the card names the new id
no_prior_value.model_delete: removes a model entry: the value goes away and is not replaced, and the card names the model
no_prior_value.guard_revoke: a free row: it only withdraws a grant, so it is never put to the person and no approval carries lines
no_prior_value.voice_person_forget: deletes a voiceprint: the value goes away and is not replaced, and the card names the person
no_prior_value.session_delete: deletes a past chat: the value goes away and is not replaced, and the card names the chat

actions.what: Switch the persona
Load or unload a model in the model server
Download an offline map region
Remove an offline map region
Sign in to the console with the password
actions.reason: A credential check: the assistant signing itself in would defeat the sign-in.

actions.what: Sign out of the console
actions.reason: Ends the person's own browser session; the model has no session of its own to end.

actions.what: Register or remove the console passkey
actions.reason: Binds a credential to the person's own device; it needs their authenticator.

actions.what: Set the pairing secret
actions.reason: A secret the person chooses; the model must never choose or see the one that gates pairing.

actions.what: Approve or deny a tool call, or answer a clarifying question
actions.reason: The approval is the person's check on the model; the model answering it would remove the check.

actions.what: Allow or refuse a phone's request for access
actions.reason: Consent is the phone owner's to give; a tool that grants it is the bypass the consent exists to stop.

actions.what: Set whether a paired device may answer held requests, or revoke a device's house key
actions.reason: Who may answer an approval is the person's check on the model, and a key the model itself runs on is among the ones listed: a tool for either lets it name its own approver or cut the person's devices off.

actions.what: Enrol a voice for speaker identity
actions.reason: Needs the person speaking into a microphone; a recorded or synthetic enrolment is the attack.

actions.what: Sign in by voice
actions.reason: A voice check of whoever is at the microphone; the model cannot stand in for them.

actions.what: Claim an unrecognised voice as mine
actions.reason: Links a voice to a person on that person's say-so; the model attributing voices would forge identity.

actions.what: Add a person to voice identity or change their level
actions.reason: Sets who the house trusts and how far; the trust level is the owner's decision, not the model's.

actions.what: Record walkthrough progress
actions.reason: Records which steps this person has seen; it is their own onboarding state, not the house's.

actions.what: Stop the turn in progress
actions.reason: The person's own stop button on the model; the model cancelling its own turn is not a request a person makes.

actions.what: Download a model
Add a model to the model server
Change a model's settings
Delete a model
Pause or resume the standing goal
Revoke a standing approval grant
Put a setting back to the value it had before its last change
Apply a settings change that waits for a yes
actions.reason: The yes is the person's: the plugin holds the change so that whoever asked cannot also answer. Asked in words, settings_set makes the change behind its own approval card.

actions.what: Discard a settings change that waits for a yes
actions.reason: The no to a held change is the person's answer too; an assistant that could discard one could hide a change someone asked for.

actions.what: Make a pairing code for a new device
actions.reason: A code is a credential for a new device, served behind the console's own session that the model holds none for; a turn steered by injected text could pair a stranger's device.

actions.what: Revoke a paired device's key
actions.reason: Cuts a device off at the console's own session, which the model holds no credential for; a turn steered by injected text could revoke the owner's own key.

actions.what: Forget a person from voice identity
Give a device found on the network a name
Switch the model the chat uses
Delete a past chat session
Drop something that waits to be remembered

not_changes.why: The ask itself: it is how the person talks to the assistant, not a change to ask for.
Plumbing for the console's own panels over the link; it carries panel reads and layout only.
Generic transports: what they change is named by the literal call listed beside them, or is covered by a row for the caller.
Compute only: they turn input into audio, text or a route match and keep nothing.
Navigation between sessions: starting or opening a chat changes what is on screen, not the house.
Connection lifecycle and reads of the link; none writes anything on the server.
Reads and the socket's own handlers: they fetch or react and write nothing.
Read-only: each sign-in account's state with no token; connecting, testing and disconnecting stay asks to JARVIS.
